name: Bulkhead door, round pressure hatch
brief: MK-035 Bulkhead door, round pressure hatch, set in a 2.4 m wall panel. A thick hatch with a porthole, a locking wheel, a hinge block and a door-state light ring round the frame: green means the next module holds air, amber means it is cycling, red means stop (diegetic: Abbie reads the ring, not a HUD).

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
